authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Submit an asset-free inquiry asking for BayFM's current music or airplay submission process after manually completing the CAPTCHA.

businessContact.verification: No purpose-bound public music-submission email was observed on the reviewed official pages. The first-party form itself was verified as the only public Music-category contact route. No address was guessed, decoded or substituted, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.

activityVerification.evidence: The official homepage exposes a live-listening surface and current station content, while the current Program Guide lists active weekly music programming.

newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The form has a Music category and CAPTCHA but does not expressly authorize unsolicited audio delivery or disclose accepted file/link formats, metadata, release age, international eligibility, explicit-content rules or AI-origin policy. A human must use it only for an asset-free inquiry, solve the CAPTCHA manually, wait for an authorized response, and avoid sending music or private links unless BayFM confirms the route.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search and full open-pull-request patch inspection returned no existing BayFM, bayfm.org or canonical Contact-path music opportunity.
deduplication.consolidation: The Music subject, genre field and general contact workflow are stored as one pre-submission inquiry opportunity. The station street address is not treated as a physical music route, and no adjacent general subject category is counted separately.

notes: One new free-first first-party Music-category inquiry route was queued. It remains needs_manual_review because the form contains CAPTCHA and does not publish a direct music-delivery policy. No outbound action was taken.
